Alibaba · released 2025-07 · 30.5B params (3.3B active) · apache-2.0

#134 of 205 · from 2 benchmark results across 1 source · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Novita AI) · $0.12/M blended · $0.07 in / $0.27 out per 1M tokens · [novita.ai ↗](https://novita.ai/models)

[price source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · USD per 1M text tokens, standard uncached input and output. Model endpoint qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct.  Product: Serverless chat completions. API model: qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct. Settings: service tier=standard, batch=no, cache=uncached input. Additional/excluded charges: Tools, cache storage, priority service and other modalities excluded.. Currency: USD.

[context specification source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · provider maximum input tokens; not an intrinsic model maximum or legacy max\_tokens
